0022600155.text: The Pacers (2-3, third in the Central and 2.5 games back, 10th in the East) host the Brooklyn Nets (0-5, fifth in the Atlantic and 4.5 games back, 15th in the East) in their seventh game of the season, with Indiana on a two-game losing streak and Brooklyn on a five-game skid. Indiana leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 136-109 win in Brooklyn on October 25, and it also won the 2025-26 series 2-1. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain).
